items.title: Jack Teagarden Interview, 1959-10-29
items.q: But, uh, old Blanton, I couldn't, I couldn't do anything wrong. Well, to me, he is.

ctx.x: I've heard every pianist in the world, every one of them, and I never will forget that you used to say, well, I can get ideas from every pianist. He might sound very mediocre, but I'll find something that I can put in my ideas. I've never seen or heard anybody even hold a candle to you. Well, there's only two people that I know of that really thought that my playing was just, you know, on top of everybody and anything, and that was you. That's what's funny, Jack. That's right, that's right. But the thing is that…
It's an interview being recorded in the back room of the Dream Room in the 400 block of Bourbon Street. And what's the date, Jack? October?
